prompt:
以下はある英語ニュースpodcast記事のFull Story・Point One・Point Twoです。
Point One・Point Twoそれぞれについて、以下6項目を判定してください
(それぞれPASS/FAIL)。

- qa_not_caveat_only: このPointが、研究上の限界・一般化上の注意・免責事項
  だけで構成されていない場合PASS(それらに加えて実質的な新しい内容がある
  場合もPASS。留保だけでPoint枠全体が終わっている場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_full_story_paraphrase: Full Storyの要約・言い換えに留まっていない
  場合PASS(Full Storyの中心的なlogic・結論を語彙だけ変えて繰り返している
  場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_other_point_paraphrase: もう一方のPointの要約・言い換えになって
  いない場合PASS
- qa_explains_why_it_matters: 「だから何なのか」を具体的に説明できている
  場合PASS(聞き手にとっての具体的な意味・示唆がある場合)
- qa_specific_not_generic: この記事のLedger固有の内容に基づいており、他の
  どんな記事にもほぼそのまま流用できる一般論になっていない場合PASS
- qa_adds_new_value: 新しい理解・解釈・意外性・具体的示唆のいずれかを
  実際に加えている場合PASS(Full Storyだけを聞いた場合と比べて、聞き手の
  理解が実際に深まっている場合)

reasoningには、判定理由を1〜2文の日本語で書いてください(特にFAILの場合は
具体的な理由を明記してください)。

【Full Story】
A game can turn on one big swing. This one was decided by what came next.

On Sunday, August 16, Hanshin played Hiroshima at Mazda Stadium. In the first inning, Teruaki Sato hit a two-run home run to center field, giving Hanshin a 2–0 lead.

Hiroshima answered in the fifth. Elehuris Montero hit a solo home run, making the score 2–1. For a moment, Hiroshima was close again.

Hanshin’s starting pitcher, Rihito Ihara, kept the game steady. He pitched five innings, allowing two hits and one run. Hiroshima could not score again during his outing.

Hanshin added more runs in the seventh and eighth innings. Sakamoto and pinch-hitter Tairyu Fushimi brought runners home in the seventh. In the eighth, Sakamoto added another run with a double.

The game started with a quick Hanshin lead. Then it became a close 2–1 contest. But Hanshin kept adding runs, and the gap grew again.

The final score was Hiroshima 1, Hanshin 8.

【Point One】
The key detail is what did not happen after Montero’s home run. Hiroshima never produced another long attack. During Ihara’s five innings, Hiroshima had only two hits and one run. So the 2–1 score was a short interruption, not a lasting change in the game. Hiroshima came close, but it could not keep the pressure going.

【Point Two】
Hanshin’s attack changed as the game went on. Sato’s first-inning home run gave the team power at the start. Later, Sakamoto and Fushimi brought runners home, and Sakamoto’s double added another run. This was not a win decided by one swing. Hanshin used a big hit first, then found runs in important chances.
